INSERT INTO task_logs (task_id, changed_by, old_status, new_status, comment)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.body.task_id }}',
  {{ $json.body.changed_by ? "'" + $json.body.changed_by + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.body.old_status }}',
  '{{ $json.body.new_status }}',
  'Logged by n8n Flow 5: {{ $json.body.old_status }} → {{ $json.body.new_status }}'
)
RETURNING *;
SELECT created_at FROM tasks WHERE id = '{{ $json.body.task_id }}';

INSERT INTO activity_history
  (task_id, member_id, action_type, old_value, new_value, lead_time_hours, metadata)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.task_id }}',
  {{ $json.changed_by ? "'" + $json.changed_by + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  'STATUS_CHANGE',
  '{{ $json.old_status }}',
  '{{ $json.new_status }}',
  {{ $json.lead_time_hours || 'NULL' }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ source: "n8n_flow5", task_title: $json.task_title, project_id: $json.project_id }) }}'
)
RETURNING *;
